label: UEFN
description: Everything for the UEFN editor in one plugin: actors, assets, data tables, editor control, level design and worldgen, materials, modeling, Niagara VFX, Scene Graph, Verse (digests, compile, UMG, New-file templates), animation and retargeting, MetaHuman, physics, Virtual Pointer, testing, UEFN Logs and NPC AI recipes. Bundles every UEFN skill. Serial editor ops (one MCP call per turn).

steps.title: UEFN core tools ready
steps.body: Core UEFN editor MCP tools are live — actors, assets, data tables, and editor control. Creative devices and PIC sessions use nested Epic UEFN MCP.

templates.label: Daily island check at 8 AM
templates.description: Every morning at 8: waits for Fortnite's servers, opens your island, starts a session and a Tester ducky play-tests it. Problems go to a Verse Coder ducky to fix, then the session restarts and the test runs again, up to 3 tries. When it passes: a private version and a memory calculation. Either way you get a report in the Workflow reports chat (on your phone too), and a message if a step breaks. It runs from the day you create it (switch it off in the list to pause); this PC and UEFN Ducky need to be on at 8.

inputs.message:
⏸ Fortnite's servers were still down after 2 hours of checking, so today's island check didn't run.

Status: {{servers_status}}

config.prompt: A play session of this island is running with a player in it. Play-test it with the tester tools: session_status, get_editor_log, actor_state_snapshot, actor_state_diff, device_graph_snapshot, device_graph_audit, simulate_device_event, verse_test_results, workspace_list_verse_errors. Don't edit files, stop the session or restart UEFN. Check: 1) Verse compiles with no errors; 2) the player spawned and the HUD shows; 3) the island's main loop works end to end: what the player does first, what it gives back, the next step; 4) no errors or Verse runtime errors in the editor log since the session started; 5) the device audit finds no unbound device references. For each problem give what you saw (log lines, snapshot diffs), where it is (file and line, device or actor) and how to reproduce it. If you tested earlier in this run, check those problems first and say which are fixed now. End with exactly one last line: RESULT: PASS when nothing needs fixing, else RESULT: FAIL.

The play test below found problems on this island. Fix them: read the files it names, change the Verse or the device setup, then workspace_compile_verse and workspace_push_verse_changes until it compiles with no errors. Fix the cause, change only what the problems need, and don't upload, publish or change project settings. If something can't be fixed from here, say why. Reply with what you changed (file, what and why) and what to re-test. The play test's report:

Load skill_read_subskill('ducky', 'publish_private'). Do only Upload to Private Version. When 'Private version has been created!' is up, copy the island code, press OK to close the popup, and put the code in your reply.

Load skill_read_subskill('ducky', 'publish_private'). Do Launch Memory Calculation. First set the Launch Session menu to Launch on this PC if another platform is selected. If 'Private version has been created!' appears, copy the code, put it in your reply, and press OK so the client can start the calculation. Report the memory result when it returns.

templates.label: Fortnite client movement check
templates.description: With a session already launched: wait for the Fortnite client to load into play mode, a Tester ducky checks a capture, the player walks forward and the Tester proves the move from before/after captures.

nodes.label: Wait for the client to load

config.prompt: Use fortnite_client_capture and inspect the image. Confirm Fortnite is in the island with a controllable player and no menu, loading screen or popup. Do not move. Final line CLIENT: READY only if verified, else CLIENT: FAIL.

Compare the before image {{nodes.m.before}} and the after image {{nodes.m.after}} (or the attached images). Prove the character moved against fixed landmarks; input alone is not proof. Final line RESULT: PASS only if the move is proven, else RESULT: FAIL.

config.message:
Not moved: the Fortnite client was not verified ready.
{{nodes.a.text}}

templates.label: Chat: capture UEFN logs
templates.description: Chat start → Agent → Capture UEFN logs → Finish.

templates.label: Play test → capture logs → agent diagnoses
templates.description: Mark log → Start game → wait for a line → Capture → a ducky explains what happened.

config.prompt: Read the captured UEFN log lines and explain what happened and how to fix it.

nodes.label: Wait for Fortnite client
nodes.description: Wait (max 120 s) until the Fortnite client a session launched has loaded into play mode, without touching it.

nodes.label: Capture Fortnite client
nodes.description: Capture the loaded Fortnite client into the chat. Refuses while it is still loading.

nodes.label: Move Fortnite player
nodes.description: Hold W/A/S/D for 0.1–3 s in the loaded client, with before/after captures. Prove the move from the images.

nodes.label: Wait for player
nodes.description: Block until a player pawn is in the session.

nodes.label: Teleport player
nodes.description: Move the live player to a teleporter / actor label or x,y,z.

nodes.label: Expect log
nodes.description: Poll the editor log until a regex matches.

nodes.label: Mark UEFN log
nodes.description: Remember where the UEFN / client logs end now. Put it before Start game so captures only show this run.

nodes.label: Wait for UEFN log line
nodes.description: Poll the UEFN log until the pattern appears after the mark. Stops early on a FAIL line. Outputs found / failed / timed_out and never aborts the run.

nodes.label: Capture UEFN logs
nodes.description: Grab every matching log line since the mark. Outputs text, prompt (for an agent) and a uefn_log_capture.txt file.

verse.templates.name: Device + OnBegin
verse.templates.description: Single-file creative_device with OnBegin

verse.templates.name: HUD Canvas
verse.templates.description: Single-file canvas + text_block starter

verse.templates.name: Subscribe Helpers
verse.templates.description: Subscribe* wrappers with ExtraData for listenables

verse.templates.name: Player Core
verse.templates.description: player_manager + game_player + save_service. ?option slots for Economy / Progression / Playtime; per-player slot index (GetPlayerSlot).

verse.templates.name: NPC Core
verse.templates.description: Default NPC pack (like Player Core): session prey/hunter registries, prey FSM, hunter FSM, spawn controller. Compiles with no clips — duplicate react clips then Play(AS_…). Standalone; no Player Core required.

verse.templates.name: LLM NPC Conversation
verse.templates.description: An NPC you talk to by voice (UEFN 42.30 conversations): persona personality and voice from Verse, a voice channel with the players, structured output (RegisterAction) when you agree a deal, a one-shot structured Prompt, captions from CommitSayEvent. Put llm_npc_behavior on an NPC Character Definition with a Persona Modifier. Compile-verified in 42.30.

verse.templates.name: Team Text Chat
verse.templates.description: One text chat channel per team (UEFN 42.40 text_channel): team color and a [Team N] label, players join on arrival and leave on exit, read-only players (SetCanType), per-player labels (SetLabel), channel on/off. Verse can't send or read messages. Compile-verified in 42.40.

verse.templates.name: Economy Manager
verse.templates.description: Currencies + HUD canvas. Registers currency_provider. Needs Player Core.

verse.templates.name: Progression Manager
verse.templates.description: XP / levels + HUD. Registers xp_awarder. Currency rewards when Economy present.

verse.templates.name: Time Tracker
verse.templates.description: Session / playtime + offline seconds. Registers playtime_provider.

verse.templates.name: Shop Controllers
verse.templates.description: Buy + currency exchange via ?currency_provider. Standalone; no-ops without Economy.

verse.templates.name: Match Timer
verse.templates.description: Countdown/count-up controller + swappable timer_canvas builder.

verse.templates.name: Tycoon
verse.templates.description: Full plot tycoon: purchaseables, belt, pets, rebirth. Consumes Economy / Progression / Time Tracker (never owns currency/XP).

verse.templates.name: NPC Ecosystem (optional cat+dog example)
verse.templates.description: OPTIONAL cat+dog example only. Default NPC pack is npc_core → Verse/NPCCore/. Apply this pack only if the user asked for the exact cat+dog island, with parent_relative=Content/AI after duplicating react clips into that folder.

verse.templates.name: UMG Widget Device
verse.templates.description: creative_device skeleton for driving a UW_* User Widget (Verse fields + field events awaited in a race-to-stop watcher; no Subscribe until 43.00) when the project has no Verse UI Kit; with the kit, use its driver pattern (skill verse_ui_kit). Uncomment the WIDGET lines after the widget exists in the Assets digest.

verse.templates.name: Custom Entity Movement (Experimental)
verse.templates.description: Fully custom player locomotion on a Scene Graph entity: 42.10 Move input action, editable speed/accel/friction/gravity/jump, OnSimulate delta loop (TickEvents.Subscribe is Epic-internal), Scene Graph orbit camera via fort_orbit_camera_modifier on the camera's modifier stack (AddModifier = parens) plus camera_director_component.AddCamera[...] (brackets), stock character parked in stasis. Experimental: cannot publish.

verse.templates.name: VP Screen-space Trace
verse.templates.description: Virtual Pointer tap/click → DeprojectViewportToWorld → FindSweepHits. TouchMapping + PointerSelect (publishable).

verse.templates.name: VP Swipe Detector
verse.templates.description: Per-player swipe / tap classifier (Up/Down/Left/Right) from PointerSelect Begin → Trigger → End. Publishable.

verse.templates.name: VP Pinch Scale (Experimental)
verse.templates.description: PointerZoom pinch / scroll / right-stick → scale a Scene Graph entity. Experimental: cannot publish.

verse.templates.name: Virtual Pointer Pack
verse.templates.description: All three Virtual Pointer devices in Verse/VirtualPointer/: screen-space trace, swipe detector, pinch scale (Experimental).
